title: 새 책
description: An app dialog (File ▸ New ▸ Book…): the Save window of a new book file in the open project (project, given whole). folder is a folder of the project ("" the project folder itself; the list comes with the dialog), fileName the file's name (.foliobook is added when it lacks it). Applying sends book action new; when the file exists the dialog stays open asking to replace it (dialogState.confirm), and applyDialog action replace replaces it. The result is the book (path, book, status), which the screen opens. book is the project-relative path of the book open in the window (it is not saved over).
